purpose: Deterministic nominal-atomic-unit survivability model for one thin-V1 end-to-end cycle

authorityBoundary.statement: The cooperative runner cap is not an onchain system-wide loss bound. Operations custody is zero by construction, while provider, authorizer, route-executor, bridge, and policy-wallet risks remain unresolved. The model does not authorize signing, broadcast, deployment, provider mutation, asset movement, or spending.

numericBasis.crossAssetRule: No exchange rate or atomic-unit equality is assumed; the model records each finalized asset delta independently.

feeBasisPoints.process: total minus rounded Programmable and treasury liabilities

hookFeeBasisPoints.process: total minus independently rounded Programmable and treasury amounts

executedUsdgNormalization.specifiedUsdg: abs(params.amountSpecified), after the returned hook delta restores the final caller specified delta exactly
executedUsdgNormalization.unspecifiedUsdg: abs(raw PoolManager swap delta), before the afterSwap unspecified hook delta is subtracted from the caller delta

lossAbsorbers.absorber: The process liability receives only totalFee minus the two independently rounded liabilities.
Segregated liabilities and exact atomic state transitions keep every recorded liability fully backed.
A separately authorized runner action cap limits only the cooperative action bundle; it is not enforced by the hook.
The immutable vault destination and vault-to-hook payout path keep Operations process-principal and returned-proceeds custody exposure at exactly zero.

lossAbsorbers.loss: provider, authorizer, route-executor, bridge, or policy-wallet compromise
lossAbsorbers.absorber: No numeric upper bound is claimed before exact live bindings. These risks remain separate unresolved nonzero classes.

lossAbsorbers.loss: payout underfunding or commitment above return
lossAbsorbers.absorber: Payout funding atomically consumes one cycle-bound proceeds key and exactly the independently observed final PegCycleVault USDG credit.

lossAbsorbers.loss: duplicate, redirected, or short holder payment
lossAbsorbers.absorber: Structured recipient-bound leaves and one payout-and-index paid key reject real adversarial calls without mutation.

lossAbsorbers.loss: rejected or replayed cooperative runner action
lossAbsorbers.absorber: Each cooperative runner action checks its asset-specific cap and consumes its exact authorization and receipt once; this does not bound unresolved provider or custody-component compromise.
Every failed leaf stays fully funded and independently payable through the same non-expiring permissionless path.

excludedFromModel: expected profitability or recurring pack economics
route discovery, quote reliability, or automatic retry queues
USDG or Circle USD Coin price deviation, issuer action, or chain liveness
native-gas conversion to USDG; exact per-asset gas caps bind only after provider selection
cryptographic Merkle proof construction and publication transport; those require independent implementation spikes
runtime bytecode, initcode, and payment gas headroom; those require implementation and official limits
Phase 2 automation, recipient replacement, or any system-wide payout-count policy
